title: Oaxacan-Style Pork Birria Italian-Style Stew
description: A fusion twist on traditional birria, this Italian-inspired stew combines the rich flavors of Oaxacan slow-cooked pork with Italian seasonings and herbs.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, and bay leaves. Stir to combine.
Add the shredded pork to the pot and stir to coat with the sauce.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
